item.title: 09-01 Persia 2.0: Global Dimension. Freedom as Structure (Open Ecosystem)
item.description: Persia proposes a new global model in which freedom functions as infrastructure. Open protocols, transparent institutions, and visible systemic flows create stability through openness rather than force.
